description: Create a LinkedIn CONVERSION RULE — the object LinkedIn attributes conversions to, and the prerequisite for send_linkedin_conversions. `type` is the behaviour being tracked (LEAD, PURCHASE, SIGN_UP, QUALIFIED_LEAD, KEY_PAGE_VIEW…). THE RULE IS BORN ASSOCIATED WITH NOTHING: until you attach campaigns with associate_linkedin_conversion_campaigns it attributes nothing, which also makes it the safe place to send test events — LinkedIn has no test mode on the wire. Pass associateAllCampaigns:true to attach it to up to 200 ACTIVE campaigns instead; that spends nothing but it changes what those live campaigns optimise toward and what their reports count, so ask the user first. Attribution windows are 1, 7, 30 or 90 days (365 only for SUBMIT_APPLICATION, PURCHASE, ADD_TO_CART, QUALIFIED_LEAD and LEAD). Creating a rule cannot spend money — it is a definition. Free.

adAccountId.description: LinkedIn ad account id shared with this profile; needed only when several are shared

associateAllCampaigns.description: attach to up to 200 ACTIVE campaigns now — ask the user first

associateCampaignsByObjective.description: attach only to campaigns whose objective matches this conversion type

attributionType.description: how conversions are credited across campaigns: last touch by campaign or by conversion

enabled.description: default true. A disabled rule REFUSES streamed events.

name.description: shown in Campaign Manager and in every report

postClickAttributionWindowSize.description: 1, 7, 30 or 90 days (365 for the five long-window types). LinkedIn default 30.

type.description: the conversion behaviour, e.g. LEAD, PURCHASE, SIGN_UP, QUALIFIED_LEAD, KEY_PAGE_VIEW

valueType.description: DYNAMIC (default) takes each event’s own value

name: create_linkedin_conversion_rule
title: Create a LinkedIn conversion rule
